reason: The image shows complete opacification (whiteout) of the left hemithorax, obscuring the left lung field, heart border, and hemidiaphragm. Additionally, a large-bore central venous catheter is present in the right chest. These findings represent significant abnormalities.
case_description: A portable frontal chest radiograph demonstrating total opacification of the left hemithorax with mediastinal shift or obscuration. A dual-lumen central venous catheter is visible entering from the right side with its tip projecting over the superior vena cava/right atrial junction. The right lung field appears relatively aerated but shows some haziness.
